# Version 4.157.0 (Unreleased)
> **GPU geometry and clipping**

## Highlights

The upcoming 4.157.0 release corrects transformed GPU geometry, Ganesh empty flushes, and Graphite clip-stack capacity handling. The native corrections retain Skia m157 without changing managed APIs or generated bindings.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Transformed ellipse and rounded-rectangle geometry** — Corrects mixed matrix-axis coefficients when transforming rounded-rectangle radii and ellipse and rounded-rectangle stroke widths. Corner radii are clamped to half the transformed bounds to prevent overlap. ([#5688](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5688))
- **Ganesh empty-flush handling** — Advances draw tokens and catches up flush tokens after empty flushes so atlas work scheduled during one flush is not treated as pending later. ([#5688](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5688))
- **Graphite clip-stack capacity** — Counts clip elements that still need recording without double-counting recorded clips, and accepts passes exactly at capacity. Draws whose full effective clip stack cannot fit in a fresh pass are warned about and skipped instead of exceeding render-step capacity. ([#5688](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5688))
